# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User's coding standards and conventions:
- Naming: camelCase for variables/functions, ALL_CAPS_WITH_UNDERSCORES for constants, PascalCase for classes
- 80 character line limit
- 2-5 space indentation (consistent)
- Single arg: f(x); multi-arg: f( x, y, z )
- Variables grouped at scope start or nearest use, initialized at declaration
- No global variables unless permitted
- Blank lines: 2 before functions, 1 after variable groups, 1 before/after grouped statements
- Braces at same indentation as control structure
- Comments: clear, on-point; inline comments start immediately right of statement; max 2 lines single-line, else block
- Header required: name, date written, date last modified, description, academic integrity
